title: Binary monomial expansion
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a set of coordinates in $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$, and let $x$ assign a bit in $\\mathbb{F}_2$ to each coordinate. Encode each bit as the sign $(-1)^b$. The sign monomial on $S$ equals $\\displaystyle\\sum_{T\\subseteq S}(-2)^{|T|}\\prod_{i\\in T}\\mathbf{1}_{\\{x_i=1\\}}$, where the product over the empty set is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite set of coordinates among $n$
$x$ is a bit-valued assignment on those coordinates
